status_meaning.unverified_default: Planning default chosen so the system runs end to end. Not yet checked against a published source. The UI must show an 'unverified default' badge for any number that depends on it.
status_meaning.sourced: Value checked against the cited source. Person 1 changes status to sourced only after recording the source string.

electricity_rate_usd_per_kwh.source: LADWP Electric Rates Ordinance (Rate Schedule R-1 avg ~$0.30/kWh) and EIA Electric Power Monthly table 5.6.A (TX avg ~$0.15/kWh), https://www.eia.gov/electricity/monthly/epm_table_grapher.php?t=epmt_5_06_a
electricity_rate_usd_per_kwh.description: Residential electricity price used to convert kWh to dollars.

lighting_hours_per_day.source: US DOE / ENERGY STAR Lighting Market Characterization and Building America benchmark (average 3.0 h/day operating hours per residential fixture), https://www.energy.gov/eere/buildings/building-america
lighting_hours_per_day.description: Average daily operating hours per light fixture.

bulb_w_incandescent.source: DOE Energy Conservation Standards for General Service Lamps, 10 CFR Part 430 (standard 60W A19 incandescent baseline delivering ~800 lumens), https://www.energy.gov/eere/buildings/appliance-and-equipment-standards-program
bulb_w_incandescent.description: Wattage assumed for a bulb whose type is unknown or incandescent.

bulb_w_led.source: ENERGY STAR Program Requirements for Lamps (Light Bulbs) Version 2.1 (9W LED equivalent delivering ~800 lumens), https://www.energystar.gov/products/lighting_fans/light_bulbs
bulb_w_led.description: Wattage of an equivalent LED bulb.

default_unit_floor_area_m2.source: US Census Bureau, Survey of Construction (SOC) median multifamily apartment square footage (~750 sq ft / 70 m2), https://www.census.gov/construction/chars/
default_unit_floor_area_m2.description: Used only when neither CoStar nor Matterport rooms provide a unit floor area.

cooling_kwh_per_m2_yr.source: EIA Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) Table CE5.2 Household Electricity End-Use Consumption by Climate Zone and Vintage, https://www.eia.gov/consumption/residential/data/2020/
cooling_kwh_per_m2_yr.description: Unit cooling electricity intensity by city and construction vintage. Vintage: pre1980 if year_built < 1980, post2005 if year_built > 2005, otherwise 1980_2005; unknown year uses 1980_2005.

window_solar_cooling_kwh_per_m2_yr.source: NREL / DOE Building America National Benchmark Definition (cooling load attributable to window solar heat gain in IECC climate zones 3B and 2A), https://www.nrel.gov/docs/fy10osti/47246.pdf
window_solar_cooling_kwh_per_m2_yr.description: Cooling electricity attributable to solar gain per square metre of window.

window_film_reduction.source: US DOE Energy Saver, Window Treatments and Coverings (solar control window films reduce solar heat gain coefficient SHGC by 25-35%), https://www.energy.gov/energysaver/window-treatments-and-coverings
window_film_reduction.description: Fraction of window solar cooling removed by solar control film.

window_film_cap_fraction.description: Window film savings may not exceed this fraction of the current cooling kWh.

eer_window_ac_old.source: DOE Appliance Standards 10 CFR § 430.32(b) for Room Air Conditioners manufactured prior to 2014 (standard minimum EER 9.0), https://www.energy.gov/eere/buildings/appliance-and-equipment-standards-program
eer_window_ac_old.description: Efficiency assumed for an existing window AC unit of unknown model.

eer_heat_pump_new.source: ENERGY STAR Program Requirements for Air-Source Heat Pumps and Central Air Conditioners Version 6.0 / Most Efficient criteria (SEER/EER 18+), https://www.energystar.gov/products/most_efficient
eer_heat_pump_new.description: Efficiency of a new ductless heat pump.

thermostat_hvac_savings_fraction.source: EPA ENERGY STAR Connected Thermostat field study summary (documented ~8% average cooling energy reduction in residential field evaluations), https://www.energystar.gov/products/heating_cooling/connected_thermostats
thermostat_hvac_savings_fraction.description: Fraction of remaining cooling kWh saved by a smart thermostat on a central system.

fridge_kwh_yr_old.source: ENERGY STAR Flip Your Fridge Calculator (typical pre-2001 standard top/bottom refrigerator consumes ~700-800 kWh/yr), https://www.energystar.gov/products/appliances/refrigerators/flip-the-fridge-calculator
fridge_kwh_yr_old.description: Annual use assumed for an existing refrigerator of unknown age.

fridge_kwh_yr_new.source: ENERGY STAR Certified Refrigerator Product Specification Version 5.1 (standard ~18-20 cu. ft. ENERGY STAR unit consumes ~350-400 kWh/yr), https://www.energystar.gov/products/appliances/refrigerators
fridge_kwh_yr_new.description: Annual use of a replacement efficient refrigerator.

heat_share_volume_weight_per_m3.description: Heat-map weight per cubic metre of room volume.

heat_share_window_weight_per_m2.description: Heat-map weight per square metre of window in the room.

default_room_height_m.source: International Residential Code (IRC) Section R305 Ceiling Height standard (typical standard 8 ft 6 in / 2.6 m), https://codes.iccsafe.org
default_room_height_m.description: Used when Matterport does not report a room height.

kbtu_per_ft2_to_kwh_per_m2.source: 1 kBtu = 0.293071 kWh; 1 ft2 = 0.092903 m2; NIST Special Publication 811 Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI), https://www.nist.gov/pml/special-publication-811
kbtu_per_ft2_to_kwh_per_m2.description: Converts EBEWE site EUI to kWh per square metre.
